card.name: Partway through warning-section terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of long medical words in warning and contraindication headings, mostly the 'ers' in Hypersensitivity. It also fires on pieces of Anaphylaxis, Impairment, Metabolism and Cancer.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity split
modes.description: The 'ers' or 'hypers' piece inside the word hypersensitivity, usually in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Other heading words
modes.description: Pieces inside other long words in warning headings, such as Anaphylaxis, Impairment or Metabolism.
